_doc: Whether a sound heard while Jarvis speaks is the person cutting in. One rule, two implementations: android-app BargeIn.kt and jarvis-web src/lib/hud/bargeIn.ts; both test suites read this file. A scenario feeds [from_ms, until_ms, level, cut] spans at step_ms with the given floor and expects whether the reply was cut during each span.

scenarios.name: Jarvis heard back through its own speaker does not cut itself off
a person clearly over the reply, held, does
nothing interrupts while the echo is being learnt
